headword: {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}

definitions.explanation: A dietary approach that limits the intake of sugars and carbohydrates. Widely popular in Japan as a weight-loss and health management method.

examples.japanese: {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦{痩|や}せた→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧。
examples.english: I lost three kilograms on a low-carb diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The doctor recommended carbohydrate restriction, but it's hard to give up white rice.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common health and diet term in modern Japan. Often shortened to ⟦{糖質|とうしつ}→糖質：11091_toushitsu⟧⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧ or {低糖質|ていとうしつ} on food packaging. Distinct from ⟦{炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}→炭水化物：06208_tansuikabutsu⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧, which is more technical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧ (low-carb diet)
- {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}{食|しょく} (carb-restricted meals)
- ゆるい{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん} (loose/moderate carb restriction)
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん} (strict carb restriction)
